chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, Makedonia gamah a om pawlpite tungah a bawl Pasian’ hehpihna thupha note zong kong zasak uh hi.
Tua pawlpite in a zawn’ khalna hanga ze-etna tampi a thuak lai takun, a lungdamna uh lian ahih ciangin nakpi zawngkhal napi-in sumpi piakna nasia takin a khang hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amau in a hih theih zah tham loin, a hih theih zah sanga tamzaw amau lungsim ut thu-in piak nopna lungsim a nei uh hi ci-in teci ka pang hi.
Amaute in misiangthote’ vakna huhna a nasep theih nading uh hansuahna zolna kam tampi tawh kote kiangah hong thuum uh hi.
Tua bang a hih uh ciangin kote lawpna zah tham loin a hih uh a, Pasian deihna tawh kituakin a masa-in Pasian kiangah ahi zongin, kote kiangah ahi zongin, amau mahmah hong kipia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Titu in note kiangah hong kipatsa bangin hih hehpihna zong a zawh khit nadingin kote in amah ka hanthawn uh hi.
Ahih hangin note in upna, thuhilhna, pilna, hahkatna a pawlpawl leh nong itna uh-a kipan na khempeuh tawh na dim uh mah bangin hih hehpih piakna zong na dimsak ta un.
Tua bang kong cih ciangin thupiakna tawh hong ci ka hi kei hi. Midangte’ hahkatna paulamin note itna lungsim in a man hiam, a man lo hiam, ze-etna tawh kong ci hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, i Topa Zeisu Khazih in a hau napi-in zawngkhalna a thuakna tawh note in hauhna na ngah nadingun note tangdingin zawngkhalna a thuak thupha hehpihna na thei uh hi.
Hih thu panin keimah in ka lungsim ngaihsutna kong lak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nikumin lungsim hanciamna-ah zong note in a pia masa bek hi loin a ut masa na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nidang lai-inah hih nopna lungsim hanciamna a om mah bangin tu-in na hih theih zahun hih un la, hih thu na zosiang un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih nopna lungsim a om leh, hih zawh lohna ngaihsun loin, hih zawh ding bek ngaihsutna in a deihhuai na ahi hi.
Hih thu kong gen ciangin midangte in noptuamna ngahin note in zawn’na na thuak nading uh hanciam ka hi kei hi.

“A tam a kaikhawmpa’ aa dim val lo a, tawm a kaikhawmpa’ aa dim lah lo hi,” ci-a Lai Siangtho’ kam bangin a kihawmna thu ngaihsunin, tu-in note’ hauhna in amaute zawn’na huhin ahi zongin, a nungciangin amaute hauhna in note’ zawn’na hong huhin ahi zongin, a kikim dimdiamin a suah nading ka hanciam hi.
Note ading huhna hahkatna ka hanciamna bang uh Titu’ lungsim sungah a guang Pasian in phatna ngah ta hen.
Amah in kote hanthotna thu a ngai tham loin, hih nopna lungsim nei a, ama thu-in note kiangah hong pai hi.
Pasian’ Lungdamna Thu hilhna-ah pawlpi khempeuh lakah phatna a ngah sanggampa zong Titu tawh kong sawl khawm uh hi.
Tua sanggampa in Pasian’ pahtawina ahi zongin, komau lungsim phatna ahi zongin kilangsak a, hehpihna sumpi piakna nasepna-ah kote tawh hong tonkhawm dingin pawlpite in teelin a koihpa ahi hi.
Kote in tua a tampi sumpi piak hehpihna na ka sep lai takun mawhsakna a om loh nadingin ka kikem uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa mai bek hi lo, mite mai-ah zong a kilawm a kituaka gamtat ding ka hanciam uh hi.

Tua nihte tawh a dang sanggampa zong kong paisak uh hi. Tua sanggampa na khempeuh ah tam veipi ka ze-et uh a, ka theih bangin a hahkatpa ahi hi. Tu-in note a hong muan’ mahmah maninah a hahkat semsem hi.

Titu in bang ci bang mi ahi hiam ci-a hong dong mi a om leh, ka kikholhpih ka lawmpa ahi hi, note huh dingin kei tawh a semkhawm mi zong ahi hi. I sanggamte zong bang ci bang mite ahi uh hiam ci-a hong dong mi a om leh, pawlpi’ sawltakte ahi uh hi, Khazih in a pahtawi mite zong ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin note ki-itna uh ahi zongin, kote in note hangah ka kisaktheih nading uh ahi zongin pawlpite mai-ah tuate tungah a kilangin na lak un.
